description: This certificate course is designed to develop skilled professionals in the field of drone programming by providing industry-relevant knowledge and practical competencies. Developed in consultation with domain experts, the qualification aims to prepare a future-ready workforce capable of meeting the growing demands of the drone industry while promoting both employment and entrepreneurship opportunities. The course provides comprehensive training in drone technology, including drone classification, regulatory and ethical aspects, drone subsystems, payload installation, system integration and testing, programming, maintenance, and troubleshooting, enabling learners to effectively develop, operate, and maintain drone-based solutions across various applications.
